##### Project general facts

Soulever is a contemporary waterfront residential development located in Dubai Maritime City, defined by its sculptural architecture and seamless connection to the surrounding coastal landscape. The project comprises two elegant towers rising 44 and 31 storeys, designed with refined lines, layered balconies, and light-filled terraces that maximize panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and the city skyline. The architecture emphasizes openness, natural light, and airflow, creating a harmonious living environment where indoor and outdoor spaces blend effortlessly.

Residents benefit from a curated range of amenities designed to balance relaxation, wellness, and social living. The development features infinity pools, a fully equipped fitness studio, wellness lounges, and landscaped podium gardens, along with a cinema, library, residents’ club, and dedicated leisure areas. Carefully designed communal spaces and green surroundings create a tranquil yet vibrant atmosphere, while the prime location ensures convenient access to Dubai’s key cultural and commercial destinations.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, reflecting a refined and contemporary aesthetic. Apartments feature open-plan layouts, natural stone elements, and soft neutral palettes that enhance the sense of space and comfort. Kitchens are equipped, providing practicality and everyday convenience. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from thoughtfully designed layouts and a premium architectural foundation.


##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a dynamic and specialized community at the core of Dubai, dedicated to serving the maritime industry. As a comprehensive maritime hub, it offers a full spectrum of infrastructure, services, and facilities that support shipbuilding, maintenance, and a wide range of marine-related activities.

The area is purposefully designed to accommodate maritime businesses and professionals, featuring advanced shipyards, dry docks, and zones for maritime services and marine equipment suppliers. It also hosts educational and training institutions focused on the maritime field, creating a well-rounded ecosystem for industry growth and innovation.

Strategically located near Dubai’s key ports and transport networks, Dubai Maritime City provides excellent connectivity to international trade routes. This advantageous positioning ensures efficient logistics, easy access for businesses and residents, and strengthens its role as a vital link in the global maritime chain.
